activity_summary: Standing, with the pen still in your hand, you said that in July you had said they jest first and then somebody is out, and that you had not known it would be him. You said Phillips will never forgive you. It is the best part in the play, and he is dead by three o'clock. You did not go and tell him.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke it standing, and stayed in the room.

entities.name: the best part

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: In July I said they jest first and then somebody's out. I didn't know it would be him.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Phillips will never forgive me. Best part in it, and dead by three o'clock.
